lines.q: Which has more people, Brazil or Nigeria?
lines.a: Nigeria! About two hundred thirty three million, twenty million more than Brazil.
Japan! Around one hundred twenty four million, even though its population is shrinking.
Canada! About forty million, Australia has around twenty seven.
Kazakhstan! More than twice as many people. Think you can beat all four? Go again!
